sloka: अभिवादयमानम् तम् दृष्ट्वा ससुहृदम् सुतम् ।मुदा अश्रु मोक्ष्यसे क्षिप्रम् मेघ लेका इव वार्षिकी ॥२-४४-२७॥
transliteration: abhivādayamānam tam dṛṣṭvā sasuhṛdam sutam ।mudā aśru mokṣyase kṣipram megha lekā iva vārṣikī ॥2-44-27॥

translations.english: Like a flake of cloud in monsoon, you are going to shed tears of joy soon seeing your son along with his friends bowing to you in reverence.
